name: browser-relay
description: <用户自制> 浏览器会话：选择 Chrome、Ego Lite 或 Linux 无头浏览路线。 Route browser tasks to Web Access for Chrome, Ego Lite when Chrome automation is too slow, or Playwright for Linux headless work.

interface.longDescription: Use Web Access for Chrome, try Ego Lite when Chrome automation is too slow and the task can use a separate browser, or use Playwright for Linux headless work. Includes an optional Playwright smoke check.
